title: Plugin Manifest v1
description: Plugin Subsystem v1 manifest vocabulary (MANIFEST.yaml). Additive epoch 1.0.3 (CON §8). FROZEN surface per .agents/shared/planning/plugin-subsystem/v1-interface-contracts.md §2. Unknown fields are refused by construction (additionalProperties: false at every level). Division of labor: THIS SCHEMA expresses vocabulary SHAPE (types, enums, allowed keys); policy checks whose refusal codes are semantically demanded by the validation matrix (kebab name, alarm_owner presence, parity section presence, divergence-entry well-formedness, fence completeness, tag-only pins) live in daemon/plugin_subsystem/manifest_reader.py and deliberately carry no structural constraint here, so the dedicated code always wins over a generic structural code. Epoch history: 1.0.0 (slice ①+①① baseline: schema + 3-class vocab); 1.0.1 (slice ④ lift: admits the new top-level ``skills`` section per CON §6 plugin-skill declaration; ADDITIVE on no frozen surface — no field removed, no enum tightened, no section renamed); 1.0.2 (slice ⑤ lift: C→B element + ports section + own_outright.attribution; ADDITIVE on no frozen surface — no field removed, no enum tightened, no section renamed); 1.0.3 (slice ⑥ lift: divergence_register entry optional ``status`` disposition enum (registered/open/resolved, CON §5 entry shape); ADDITIVE on no frozen surface — no field removed, no enum tightened, no section renamed).

schema_version.description: SemVer. Plugin #1 authors against the literal "1.0.0". 1.0.x = additive only; the validator accepts the 1.0.x family and refuses anything else until the runner carries the newer schema. Current additive epoch: 1.0.3 (divergence_register entry status enum, slice ⑥).

name.description: kebab-case; MUST match the plugin directory name (semantic checks name_invalid / name_dir_mismatch in manifest_reader).

license.description: SPDX id; validated exact-match against plugins-convention/spdx_ids.json (semantic code license_invalid; validator list is EVOLVABLE, field carry FROZEN).

tag_pin_per_class.description: TAG-ONLY pins per provenance class (semantic code non_tag_pin refuses SHAs/empties; full branch-vs-tag discrimination is vendoring-time, slice 3). snapshot_with_drift_alarm absent => inherit copy_freely pin. own_outright is never synced, so it carries no pin.

integration_path.description: "A" only with a complete fence_grant block (semantic code fence_missing).

execution_mode.description: POSITIVE declaration; absent => REFUSE (silence is not permission). Enforced semantically with refusal code absent_execution_mode, hence deliberately not in the schema-level required set.

lifted_symbol.description: B-path field (required iff execution_mode=lifted-symbol; row required_manifest_fields, semantic code missing_required_manifest_fields).

entrypoint.description: B-path field; relative path rooted under adapter/ (semantic code entrypoint_invalid). <=200-line tripwire numeric CI lands with the first real plugin trees (slice 2).

runtime_pin.description: Exact version pin; ranges refused (semantic code runtime_pin_not_exact, strict peer-dep).

ipc_schema_pin.description: Semver pin of the IPC schema.

fence_grant.description: FROZEN block; required iff integration_path=A. Field-level absence is semantic code missing_required_manifest_fields (row required set); block completeness (non-empty rationale/granted_by/granted_at) is semantic code fence_missing — deliberately no schema-level required/minLength so the dedicated codes win.

copy_freely.description: Clean-pulled upstream data; never authored locally. alarm_owner REQUIRED (semantic code alarm_owner_missing; empty/missing both refuse) — deliberately not schema-required so the dedicated code wins.

paths.description: Globs relative to the plugin tree root.

alarm_owner.description: Role-or-team that owns this class's drift alarms.

escalation.description: EVOLVABLE placeholder; v1 default semantics: block-promote-after-days with N=14.

snapshot_with_drift_alarm.description: Hot upstream content snapshotted with drift alarms + reconcile. Non-empty paths REQUIRE a non-empty, well-formed divergence_register (semantic codes empty_divergence_register / divergence_entry_malformed) — deliberately not schema-required. The optional `upstream_paths` field (additive per CON §8 1.0.x rule) is the parallel mapping: paths[i] is the LOCAL subtree, upstream_paths[i] is the corresponding UPSTREAM subtree. When absent, the sync-runner falls back to the strip-class-prefix heuristic (matches the copy_freely layout where local and upstream share the trailing path).

upstream_paths.description: Optional additive field (CON §8 1.0.x): parallel to paths. paths[i] is the LOCAL subtree; upstream_paths[i] is the corresponding UPSTREAM subtree. Same length as paths. Required when the local class subtree is renamed relative to the upstream tree (e.g. the snapshot class renames apps/daemon/src/prompts/ → prompts/daemon/ for the local audit layout).

items.description: Numbered, exhaustive. Required fields {id, files, delta, rationale, pinning_test} enforced semantically (divergence_entry_malformed); upstream_ref is the one optional field per the CON §2 vocabulary. ADDITIVE 1.0.3 (slice ⑥): optional ``status`` carries the disposition state (CON §5 entry shape) — see the status property description.

status.description: Optional; CON §5 entry-shape disposition state (slice ⑥). registered = pre-registered divergence POINT, no observed delta yet (the default when absent, back-compat with pre-⑥ entries); open = sync-observed, re-apply-or-drop disposition NOT yet landed (the state the sync-runner emits); resolved = disposition landed.

own_outright.description: Ensemble-authored, never synced, invisible to the sync-runner. Deliberately carries NO alarm_owner (authored locally — there is nothing upstream to alarm on) and NO divergence_register; declaring either here is a vocabulary refusal by construction. ADDITIVE 1.0.2 (slice ⑤): an optional ``attribution`` array carries license-carried-from metadata for any own_outright subtree that ports from a permissive upstream source (e.g. Apache-2.0 §4(d) attribution obligation). Schema-level shape only — the semantic check on attribution rows lives in manifest_reader.

attribution.description: ADDITIVE 1.0.2 (slice ⑤). Per-subtree attribution metadata for own_outright content that ports from a permissive upstream source. Each entry documents the upstream license, source, and rationale. Schema-level shape only; semantic check (SPDX id, license-carried-from token present, etc.) lives in manifest_reader.

path.description: Subtree path relative to own_outright/ that this attribution row covers.

license_carried_from.description: SPDX id (e.g. 'Apache-2.0') of the upstream source this subtree ports from.

upstream_source.description: URL of the upstream source (commit-pinned where possible; the canonical example is the open-design-mcp@0.16.1 source repo).

upstream_commit.description: Optional commit SHA / tag of the upstream source at the time of port.

rationale.description: Plain-language rationale for the port (e.g. 'Apache-2.0 §4(d) — copy + attribution + state of changes; the orchestration is pure formatting').

parity_boundary.description: REQUIRED SECTION (semantic code missing_parity_boundary — deliberately not schema-required so the dedicated code wins). Subsections are lists that may be empty; any row present must carry non-empty {path, reason} (semantic code parity_row_malformed).

skills.description: Optional plugin-skill section (CON §6; slice ④). When present, declares the named plugin-skills the plugin contributes to the registration path. Each entry's per-skill contract (plugin_ref, vendored_references, consumption.by) lives in the SKILL YAML at plugins/<name>/skills/<skill_id>.yaml and is validated by the slice-④ skill loader — the manifest only NAMES the skills here so a missing skill YAML surfaces as a refusal at scan time (not at consumer query time).

skill_id.description: Skill identifier (kebab / dotted). Must equal the source file's stem at plugins/<name>/skills/<skill_id>.yaml.

path.description: Relative path to the skill YAML inside the plugin tree (CON §6: typically 'skills/<skill_id>.yaml'). Refused if it escapes the plugin tree ('..' / absolute).

ports.description: ADDITIVE 1.0.2 (slice ⑤). Reference surface for the plugin's Port declarations (CON §3 FROZEN Port data-contract schema). The actual Port data contracts live in Python code at daemon/plugin_subsystem/<plugin>/ports.py; this manifest section carries ONLY the reference (port_id + version + adapter_id + consumers + capability_tags) so a reviewer can see the surface at a glance and so the schema-CI runner can validate without re-encoding the schemas. The frozen Port schema surface (inputs_schema / outputs_schema / errors.envelope) is NOT duplicated here — duplicated YAML would inflate the manifest past the 64 KB hard-cap (CON §1) by the time 4 ports × 4 large fields are present. When absent, the plugin has no declared Ports (C-path resource-only plugins without Ports).

port_id.description: Stable dotted-kebab Port identifier (e.g. 'od.generate'). Must match the dotted-kebab pattern (CON §3, FROZEN).

adapter_id.description: Stable wrapper identifier (e.g. 'opendesign.generate.v1') matching the Port's provider.adapter_id exactly. The plugin_tool_factory's ADAPTER_REGISTRY maps this to the Python module + class implementing the Port.

consumers.description: NAMED consumers only (CON §3 — anonymous '["*"]' is refused at the seam gate). At least one consumer required.

declared_in.description: Reference path to the Python module where the Port's full data contract is declared (the single source of truth for inputs_schema / outputs_schema / errors.envelope).

notes.description: Free-form reviewer note (the schema-CI runner does not inspect this field; it's documentation only).
